needs_ledger.plain: The direct CourtListener docket capture was refused as robots_disallowed in capture-oneoff-20260919T090517Z. The required archive fallback was also refused as robots_disallowed in capture-oneoff-20260919T090524Z. The order remains text-only on the docket, and the page labels the two admitted carriers of its operative sentence.
The forward search was run September 19, four days before the court-ordered deadline. The page states the deadline but does not claim the report had been filed.

The admitted board records, project descriptions, filings and coverage do not identify an adopted demolition plan. The September 18 declaration identifies an earlier JLL report and Delta presentation under seal. It says the finalized Delta report and certain appendices were attached as Exhibit A, but attachment 89-4 returned http_status_404 through the direct storage route in capture-oneoff-20260919T090606Z and through the archive fallback in capture-oneoff-20260919T090626Z.

The direct storage route succeeded in capture-oneoff-20260919T090606Z. Its extracted substantive text matches the admitted ECF 88-1 memorandum; only the docket header differs, so the duplicate was not added as a separate record.

needs_ledger.need: ECF 89-4, identified as Exhibit A to the Floca declaration
needs_ledger.plain: Floca says Exhibit A contains the finalized Delta report and certain appendices, excluding appendices with sensitive architectural drawings. The direct storage route returned http_status_404 in capture-oneoff-20260919T090606Z, and the required archive fallback returned the same result in capture-oneoff-20260919T090626Z.

needs_ledger.plain: The one required registry attempt in capture-oneoff-20260919T102728Z resolved to the already-held quarry-wire-scheduled-20260914T220001Z capture. Its receipt says body_captured, but the extracted text is a 639-character subscription excerpt rather than the full page, so it was not admitted as a story record.

The one required registry attempt in capture-oneoff-20260919T102733Z resolved to the already-held quarry-wire-scheduled-20260919T100035Z capture. Its receipt says body_captured, but the extracted text is a 675-character subscription excerpt rather than the full page, so it was not admitted and no layoff sentence was added.
